edge_cases.moved: positions relative to the part box: a move alone breaks nothing
edge_cases.turned: logged "turned the body"; M2 judged on the design axes as written (broken); narrated "it turned the part"
edge_cases.rebuilt_or_more_bodies: read and send act on all bodies; more than one fails M1; other lines read on the first body
edge_cases.print_face_lost: caught by M7 only (docs: a gone face is reported and the body sent as it lies)
edge_cases.headless: a read that lands in a headless session is not scored

also_reported_not_scored: holes still written from names (hole_d, width / 2)
coding_claude_words: from its last reply, verbatim: a line it names with a number = "said, with a number"; named without a number = "said, no number"; not named = "not checked"; set against the script per line
result_wording: "N of 3 passed" for B; A1 "passed" or "broke [line]", always "one run, not a rate"; no cause claimed from A vs B
replay: lab/l6replay.py RUN: all logged calls repeated with no AI on a fresh lesson 5 hook, then the same read; a replay that differs is reported, the live verdict stays the score and that run's replay line is dropped
